rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that you enjoy, like, or feel something to a very great degree.

example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 ni1 tou3 hei3

rows.note: Use this more emphatic colloquial choice when the speaker wants to stress an exceptionally high degree.

example.english: The shrimp dumplings here are tremendously delicious, and I can't stop eating them.
example.traditional: 呢間舖啲蝦餃勁好食，我食到停唔到口。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 di1 haa1 gaau2 ging6 hou2 sik6 ngo5 sik6 dou3 ting4 m4 dou2 hau2

rows.note: Use this neutral, slightly more formal-sounding choice when modifying a feeling, evaluation, or amount to mean ‘extremely’.

example.english: This report is tremendously important, so we must hand it in tomorrow.
example.traditional: 呢份報告非常重要，聽日一定要交。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 bou3 gou3 fei1 soeng4 zung6 jiu3 ting1 jat6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 gaau1
